description: This file provides a collection of API utility functions for client-server communication within the WebFrontend of the project. It includes methods for HTTP verbs (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE), and specific functions for handling work item comments, creation, status update, and URL building. It also manages authorization headers and incorporates localStorage data for user context in comment posting.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines whether a given API path is public (does not require Authorization) or protected.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds request headers, adding Authorization header for protected paths.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend, returns parsed JSON or null, throws on non-2xx responses.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON, or throws an error based on response status.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, returns parsed JSON, or throws on errors.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON or throws on error.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, sourcing creator name from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds and returns the full URL for a given API path based on current base URL.
